reason: Modelled from the Panasonic product and communication specifications: I2C 0x33, little-endian 32-bit PM registers (raw/1000 ug/m3), 16-bit particle counts and the STATE register, with a 5 V supply and 3.3 V logic. The part check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
